source.limitations: Transcribed from the Fulton County Health Department Septage Haulers PDF (HAULER_LIST_08.2026.PDF; printed footer 08/10/2026; Page 2 prints 14 TOTAL), linked as Septage Haulers from the HSTS/Sewage page (https://fultoncountyhealthdept.com/environmental/hstssewage). Publisher block on the PDF: 606 S SHOOP AVE, WAUSEON, OH 43567, Phone 1-419-337-0915, Fax 1-419-337-0561. Spellings kept as printed, including AUTOMATIC SEPTIC & WELL CORP. with the ampersand and period after CORP. and operator VICKIE PANT, KOOPS SEPTIC SERVICE LLC with no apostrophe, LAYMAN'S SEPTIC TANK CLEANING LLC and TRESSLER'S PLUMBING with the apostrophes, T.E. PRICE INC with periods in T.E. and no period after INC, RANDY MASTIN SEPTIC TANK INC with no period after INC and address 12004 STATE ROUTE 64, PRECISION WELL AND SEPTIC LLC with AND and no comma before LLC and city line NAPOLEON, OH 43567, SEPTIC & SEWER SOLUTIONS with an ampersand and no LLC and city line NAPOLEON, OH 43545, UNITED RENTALS - RELIABLE ONSITE SERVICES with the hyphen and operator line DBA: RELIABLE ONSITE SERVICES, and C & L SANITATION operator TOM STANGE GM. Street and city lines are joined with a space as printed. No local registration numbers on this PDF. Phones are shown as printed, including the leading 1-. ODH statewide bond status is not on this PDF (marked unknown). The Installer PDF and the Service Provider PDF on the parent page were not transcribed and were not merged. The ODH statewide septage-hauler bond list was not merged. A septage hauler registration is not a service-provider inspection credential. Appearance is not an endorsement. Verify with the Fulton County Health Department and ODH before you hire.
